message: Several small fixes. Canceling a sheet while it was still reading a photo or thinking up meal ideas no longer drops that result into the next one you open, and a meal idea or step picked while one was loading stays picked. A gym’s location, found after you canceled, no longer lands on the next gym you open. Rewording a meal waiting for an estimate gets an estimate for the new words. Switching how you’re traveling to an event is no longer undone by a refresh. Later Today no longer lists a task that’s waiting on another one or in a paused project. Reordering pinned tasks keeps the place of a pin that isn’t showing right now, and reordering people keeps archived people where they were. Checking off the last option of an either/or from your Apple Watch no longer changes the list open on your phone. Categories you deleted stay deleted. Subtasks can be dragged into a new order on a tag’s page, and the keyboard no longer covers the last results in Add existing task, Link a recipe and Sort the Inbox.
